value.rationale: The identity of the best initial infected vertex is a natural stochastic graph invariant. All proper diameter-three trees arise as such double stars. The theorem is a complete first-failure classification in that natural class; the first peripheral optimum on DS(2,5) has nine vertices, contrasted with the already published balanced 22-vertex cutoff. Its six exhaustive parameter cases and exact sign comparisons reveal a nonobvious asymmetry effect, rather than arbitrary isolated numerical recomputation. The claim is deliberately finite and makes no unsupported global statement.
